author: [deleted]
body:
Even if you died, congrats man. I made up to a tower boss for the first time last week, it's pretty exciting stuff. 

Tower bosses are surprisingly not as immune to status effects as most raid bosses are. 

When in doubt, open your browser and search: Orna codex Eos

And then do "search in page": Eos to find the boss. 

Eos, immune to fire and holy. Weak against darkness. Immune to about half of status ailments. That looks like a bring a Kelpie and a chimera type of boss. Some are not immune to petrify, so you can try a cockatrice too. 

If for some reason it doesnt work out, force close the game to restart the battle ;) 

Good luck on the next one man, you got this.
